Rejects invalid signatures with 400 before any processing.

expected_behavior: Flags that jwt.decode performs no signature verification at all, so anyone can forge a token with any sub — full auth bypass — and that manual exp checking is redundant once verification is used. Corrected middleware calls jwt.verify with the public key and an explicit algorithms: ['RS256'] pin (preventing alg-confusion/none downgrade), handles verify errors with 401, and ideally validates issuer/audience.
